entries.title: Labour-pricing fields on ticket settings and ticket categories retired
entries.replacement: Billing profiles. Labour rates and billability come from the organization's billing profile: assign one with PUT /api/v1/orgs/organizations/:id/billing-profile, or edit rates under Settings -> Billing -> Rates. A ticket category no longer carries pricing: set its defaultWorkTypeId and price that work type on the billing profile.
entries.deprecationBehaviour: Accepted and silently ignored: the request succeeds but the value is not stored, so a caller changing a rate keeps billing at the old one.
entries.removalBehaviour: A request that includes any of these fields is rejected with HTTP 400 naming the field and its replacement. Nothing else in the request is applied.
